flora: Podocarp fruit/receptacle (fleshy, brightly colored, berry-like base)
Spirally arranged leaves (small, lance-shaped, waxy surface)
Male pollen cone (elongated, slender, drooping from branch)
Bark detail (thin, vertically fissured, sun-bleached grey)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the unique fleshy seed bases; leaves should look soft-touch and slightly succulent; rounded, chunky branch joints to maintain the toy-like aesthetic.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant layout: Top-Left: a close-up of the vibrant red fleshy receptacle with its seed; Top-Right: a detailed spray of the spiraled evergreen leaves; Bottom-Left: a cluster of male pollen cones; Bottom-Right: a hero shot of the sun-bleached bark texture.
visual_logic.ground: Variegated red siltstone with fine sand, providing a warm, high-contrast background.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even diffused light to emphasize the translucent quality of the fleshy fruit and the waxy sheen of the leaves.
